redFirst.basis: `npx vitest run tools/ui-tests/gate-card-wait.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but no test was collected or none reached an assertion; failing without an assertion: a hand-written poll-dependent wait with another number in a scratch copy of capture-screenshots.mjs is refused, and every real call site is a helper call or an allow-listed entry with a reason (TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'some')): Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2); no error the run printed - its final ImportError/ModuleNotFoundError/AttributeError/NameError, a house abort, a missing module - names 'POLL_WAIT_ALLOWED': TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'some'); run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: tools/ui-tests/gate-card-wait.test.mjs gains a structural scan (comment/string-blanking tokenizer, bracket matcher, helper-body exclusion for waitForPoll/sleepPollWindow). A wait primitive (waitForFunction/waitForTimeout/setTimeout) is poll-dependent when its call text names RUNSTATUS/pollRunStatus or carries a number >= the poll interval read from the assembled panel (pollIntervalOf). Each such site outside the two helpers must match an entry of the new export POLL_WAIT_ALLOWED in tools/capture-screenshots.mjs (find snippet, expected site count, reason); stale, mis-counted and reasonless entries fail. The case also writes hand-written waits with another number (waitForTimeout, waitForFunction timeout, setTimeout, and a sub-interval wait naming RUNSTATUS) into scratch copies under a tmp dir (not the tree) and requires each refused, requires a 250 ms settle wait not refused, and checks both helpers still have call sites. 8 allow-list entries cover 12 real sites, each with a reason. No wait call in capture-screenshots.mjs changed. test__refs --selftest 286/286 pass; vitest file 2/2 pass.
outcome.descriptive: A new hand-written poll-dependent wait in capture-screenshots.mjs now fails a unit test unless it goes through waitForPoll/sleepPollWindow or is allow-listed with a reason.
